title.zh: ⚡️分析师解读美联储10月决议：新规透露重大制度转向信号，按兵不动背后是鹰派内部的「耐心共识」
title.en: ⚡️分析师解读美联储10月决议：新规透露重大制度转向信号，按兵不动背后是鹰派内部的「耐心共识」

current_state.zh: The Fed held rates at its October meeting on a 10-2 vote while Chair Warsh unveiled a structural overhaul of FOMC communication — including strategy-only meetings starting 2027, fewer policy meetings, and no forward guidance or dot plots — which analysts read as a hawkish 'patient consensus' rather than a dovish pivot.
